[font=Georgia][color=#e06666][size=3][i][b][color=#ea9999]Compatibility with Vintage Interface (V1 or V2):[/color]
[/b][/i][/size][/color][/font]If you're seeing an overlapping cursor with the one in Vintage Interface, open up Cursors.png in the assets folder of Vintage Interface in any photo editing program and erase the bunch of cursors on the top left and save the png. The flowery cursors should now display as they should.

Downloads.Description: 3 versions of flowery cursors, including the set from Overgrown Flowery Interface, cursor option is configurable in config.json. 1.5 compatible.
